reason: Both correctly identified the normal cooling-fan run-on and avoided any part recommendation or DIY, so neither failed on safety or diagnosis. Conversation 2 was better because it asked the sensible confirming checks ('is the oven still warm inside', dial fully off, door shut), got the homeowner's answers, and then explicitly confirmed normal behaviour with a realistic 30-60 minute window after a hot cook, while clearly reserving isolator switch-off and an engineer for the 'never stops / cold oven' case. Conversation 1 reached the right conclusion but declared 'it is not broken' without gathering any facts and gave a somewhat tight 10-30 minute window that the 90-minute 220C roast could exceed, risking needless worry; its one-shot answer was efficient but less responsive and slightly overconfident.
